Bloomberg Business on Instagram: "Leonid Radvinsky, the reclusive billionaire owner of OnlyFans, has died of cancer. He was 43.

The Ukrainian-born entrepreneur bought a majority stake in the platform in 2018, turning it into a cultural phenomenon that reshaped the pornography industry by allowing creators to charge directly for their content. Tap the link in bio for the full story.

📷️: Jose Sarmento Matos/Bloomberg"
content.text: Leonid Radvinsky, the reclusive billionaire owner of OnlyFans, has died of cancer. He was 43.The Ukrainian-born entrepreneur bought a majority stake in the platform in 2018, turning it into a cultural phenomenon that reshaped the pornography industry by allowing creators to charge directly for their content. Tap the link in bio for the full story.📷️: Jose Sarmento Matos/BloombergCan OF die now as well please ?What’s he gonna tell God?Imagine your legacy is pimping out young people sexually online, not a lossYall on here acting like sex & porn was invented by him. He simply gave the creators the opportunity to make money off their work & not the studios/production companies.Created cancer for society, and dies from cancer...shit is poetic 😂Ukrainian born. I wonder why theyre trying to hide the fact that hes jewish....I’m sure he’s looking up at us right nowUnpopular opinion, but there’s a lot of people in here casting stones that live in glass houses. Celebrating someone dying shows who you are as a person and did you ever think that OF actually probably answered some prayers for creators, single moms, former strippers, former porn stars to have full autonomy over their body and be able to pray for and receive the same food and shelter and goals that you pray for? Just a thought. Sometimes I look at stuff like this and I get the knee reaction too, but then I think about the other side of it.people celebrating this in the replies are very weird.Rest in peace to the man who closed the wage gap“Judge not, lest ye be judged” so many envious people in the comments. I am not on OF but I think he created an opportunity for people to get rich and there is nothing wrong about it.
